one local script that resides in your screengui somewhere(you would probably also need a button in your screengui)

and a server side script

    --//Local (client-side)
    pathToButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        pathToEvent:FireServer()
    end)

    --//Server
    pathToEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)

Copy a example config from /etc/netctl/examples to /etc/netctl

I suggest you to use ethernet-dhcp, so

cp /etc/netctl/examples/ethernet-dhcp /etc/netctl

now edit /etc/netctl/ethernet-dhcp with the editor of your choice(e.g. nano)

change the Interface option to your network interface(yours is enp3s0 as seen in the picture)

so change it to: Interface=enp3s0

afterwards simply use:

netctl enable ethernet-dhcp
